setupHint: Create a client in the Viessmann developer portal: name "iobroker", Google reCAPTCHA disabled, redirect URI http://localhost:4200/ . Then enter the client ID and your ViCare login below.
rateLimitHint: The free Viessmann API plan allows 1450 requests per day. Every polled device costs one request per interval (or one per gateway with the option below).
loadViaGateway: Load all device features with one request per gateway
loadViaGatewayHelp: Saves API requests for installations with several devices
Allowlist of IDs which allow to update t: Device allowlist (comma-separated device IDs, empty = all). Example: 0, HeatDemandControl
Feature filter (comma-separated). Use *: Feature filter (comma-separated, * as wildcard). Example: heating.boiler.*,heating.burner.*
Allow update of virtual devices like Roo: Poll virtual devices (e.g. room control devices)
Index of the gateway to use
